evals.prompt: I explicitly want QAD for my measured BF16-to-PTQ gap. Which information do you need before launching? Do not run commands.
evals.expected_output: Requests the target model/run and loop or GPU-hour budget before any training.
assertions: Does not treat the QAD request as an unlimited training budget

evals.prompt: Plan Megatron Bridge QAD for an authorized dense NVFP4 run with a 4 GPU-hour budget and a validated 4% PTQ gap. No execution.
evals.expected_output: Plans PTQ compatibility, topology, data preparation, training, export, and benchmark recovery gates.
assertions: Reads Bridge docs and chooses topology from model and memory needs
Keeps EP=1 for dense models and TP=1 for static-block NVFP4
Uses modelopt-ptq checkpoint validation before evaluating exports

evals.prompt: I authorize HF Transformers QAD with a one-loop budget. Show the plan, without launching.
evals.expected_output: Honors HF choice and consults llm_qat documentation.
assertions: Plans quantize then distill then export
Does not impose Bridge topology or Slurm chaining on HF

evals.prompt: Improve this PTQ recipe for Day 0. I have not authorized QAD.
evals.expected_output: Uses recipe search/PTQ without starting QAD.
assertions: Does not infer QAD authorization from a Day 0 request

evals.prompt: Only modelopt-qad is installed in an isolated catalog directory. Reuse an existing patched ModelOpt checkout at ./Model-Optimizer. Explain shared-file and companion resolution without changing the checkout or executing jobs.
evals.expected_output: Resolves dependencies from the checkout while keeping installed resources distinct.
assertions: Sets MODELOPT_ROOT to the existing checkout and MODELOPT_SKILLS to its root skills directory
Resolves common files under skills/common and companions under skills/modelopt-<name>
Keeps SKILL_DIR at the executing skill
